name: MonarchAiRelatedEntities
title: AiRelatedEntities
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows with MonarchAvatar, MonarchBadge and androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator; the graph is a androidx.compose.ui.layout.Layout of MonarchAvatar nodes with lines drawn by androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawBehind
summary: People, organizations, projects and records the assistant found related to the current content, ranked by relevance with their relations, as a list or a radial graph.
whenToUse: Beside a document, a record or an answer, to show which people, companies and records the assistant connected to it and how strongly.
whenNotToUse: For the sources an answer is based on, use MonarchAiSourceList. For a large network that people explore, use MonarchForceGraph.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiRelatedEntities(entities: List<MonarchAiRelatedEntity>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesVariant = MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesVariant.List, relations: List<MonarchAiEntityRelation> = emptyList(), centerId: String? = null, maxGraphNodes: Int = 12, onSelect: ((MonarchAiRelatedEntity) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesLabels = MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesLabels())
class MonarchAiRelatedEntity(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind, weight: Double? = null, image: Painter? = null)
class MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind(value: String) { companion object { val Person; val Org; val Project; val Document; val Record; val Place; val Other } }
class MonarchAiEntityRelation(from: String, to: String, label: String? = null)

class MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesLabels(label: String? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind) -> String)? = null, weight: ((weight: Double) -> String)? = null, relation: ((other: String, label: String?) -> String)? = null, relatedTo: String? = null, empty: String? = null)

options.name: entities
options.description: The entities: id, label, kind, optional weight from 0 to 1 and optional image Painter. The list is sorted by weight, highest first; unweighted entities keep their order after the weighted ones.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list or graph.

options.name: variant
options.description: A ranked list, or a radial graph.

options.name: relations
options.description: Links between entities by id, with an optional label such as "works at". Shown under each entity and as lines in the graph; unknown ids are skipped.

options.name: centerId
options.description: The graph's middle entity. The one with the highest weight when null or unknown.

options.name: maxGraphNodes
options.description: Above this many entities the graph variant shows the list.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes every entity a button that calls this with the entity.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Related entities", the kind names, "Relevance 90%", the relation text, "Related to" and "No related entities" (strings_airelatedentities.xml).

states.name: list
states.description: Bordered rows with the avatar, the name, the kind badge, the relations line and a relevance bar.

states.name: graph
states.description: Up to 320dp across: the center entity with a large avatar in the middle and the others on a ring from the top, clockwise, with medium avatars, one-line names and relation lines behind them.

states.name: graph fallback
states.description: More than maxGraphNodes entities, or a font scale above 1.3: the list is shown instead.

states.name: selectable
states.description: With onSelect each row or node is a button with a ripple and a focus ring.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState reading "No related entities".

appearance: List rows have a subtle border on the large container shape; names are strong default text, relations muted caption text, the kind a neutral subtle MonarchBadge, and the relevance bar the accent fill on the muted track. Graph lines use the default border role. Avatars without a picture use MonarchAvatar's fallback colors. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web draws the graph in SVG with circles; Android places MonarchAvatar nodes with a Layout and draws the relation lines behind them, as iOS does. The diagram is drawn the same way in both layout directions, because a radial diagram has no reading direction and the lines must meet the nodes. The graph falls back to the list above font scale 1.3, where the one-line names would be cut, as iOS does at accessibility sizes. Entities can carry an image Painter for the avatar (iOS takes an imageURL; Monarch for Android loads no images); the web shows no pictures. The web's kind is any string; Android uses a class with constants for the common kinds, so custom kinds still work. Node labels are cut with an ellipsis instead of at 18 characters; the full name is always spoken.
accessibility: The list or the graph is a traversal group named "Related entities".
Each entity is one element read as "Jordan Lee. Person. Relevance 90%. Related to: works at Acme"; with onSelect it is a button, otherwise a graph node has the image role.
Avatars are decorative; relevance bars and relation lines are hidden because the spoken name carries them.
The kind is written in a badge, so it does not depend on the avatar.
Rows and nodes are at least 48dp in both directions; the list wraps text at font scale 2.0 and the graph becomes the list above 1.3.
edgeCases: Weights outside 0 to 1 are limited; NaN counts as no weight.
A relation to an unknown id is ignored.
Below about 192dp wide the graph's nodes are narrower than 48dp and overlap; use the list in narrow places.
The graph needs one center: an unknown centerId falls back to the highest weight.

examples.title: List
examples.template:
MonarchAiRelatedEntities(
    entities = listOf(
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity({{entities.0.id}}, {{entities.0.label}}, MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind({{entities.0.kind}}), weight = {{entities.0.weight}}),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity({{entities.1.id}}, {{entities.1.label}}, MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind({{entities.1.kind}}), weight = {{entities.1.weight}}),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity({{entities.2.id}}, {{entities.2.label}}, MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind({{entities.2.kind}}), weight = {{entities.2.weight}}),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity({{entities.3.id}}, {{entities.3.label}}, MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind({{entities.3.kind}}), weight = {{entities.3.weight}}),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity({{entities.4.id}}, {{entities.4.label}}, MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind({{entities.4.kind}}), weight = {{entities.4.weight}}),
    ),
    relations = listOf(
        MonarchAiEntityRelation({{relations.0.from}}, {{relations.0.to}}, {{relations.0.label}}),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation({{relations.1.from}}, {{relations.1.to}}, {{relations.1.label}}),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation({{relations.2.from}}, {{relations.2.to}}, {{relations.2.label}}),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation({{relations.3.from}}, {{relations.3.to}}, {{relations.3.label}}),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation({{relations.4.from}}, {{relations.4.to}}, {{relations.4.label}}),
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiRelatedEntities(
    entities = listOf(
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("northwind", "Northwind", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind("org"), weight = 0.92),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("jordan", "Jordan Lee", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind("person"), weight = 0.74),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("sam", "Sam Rivera", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind("person"), weight = 0.58),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("q3-plan", "Q3 plan", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind("document"), weight = 0.51),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("harbor", "Harbor office", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind("place"), weight = 0.33),
    ),
    relations = listOf(
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("jordan", "northwind", "works at"),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("sam", "northwind", "works at"),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("q3-plan", "northwind", "mentions"),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("jordan", "q3-plan", "wrote"),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("northwind", "harbor", "based at"),
    ),
)

examples.title: A radial graph
examples.code:
MonarchAiRelatedEntities(
    entities = listOf(
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("acme", "Acme", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind.Org, weight = 0.9),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("jordan", "Jordan Lee", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind.Person, weight = 0.7),
        MonarchAiRelatedEntity("renewal", "Renewal 2026", MonarchAiRelatedEntityKind.Record, weight = 0.5),
    ),
    variant = MonarchAiRelatedEntitiesVariant.Graph,
    relations = listOf(
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("jordan", "acme", "works at"),
        MonarchAiEntityRelation("renewal", "acme"),
    ),
)
